baseline.description: Defaults, mirrors nneonneo's original weights, moderate time budget

fast.description: Tight time budget for quick iteration / weaker but faster play

strong.description: Larger time budget and cache, deeper max depth for stronger play

no_cache.description: Cache disabled entirely, isolates the speedup the transposition table provides

small_cache.description: Small transposition table to test memory/hit-rate tradeoff

huge_cache.description: Very large transposition table (2^26 entries, ~1GB) to test upper bound of cache benefit

empty_focused.description: Heuristic variant emphasizing empty-cell count over merges

shallow_deep_depthbias.description: Aggressive depth_bias=0 for deepest search relative to distinct tile count

huge_cache_corner_low.description: huge_cache's proven settings + a light corner/snake bonus

huge_cache_corner_mid.description: huge_cache's proven settings + a moderate corner/snake bonus

huge_cache_corner_high.description: huge_cache's proven settings + a strong corner/snake bonus

corner_sweep_10.description: Fine sweep around the round-1 winner (weight=15): corner_weight=10

corner_sweep_15.description: Fine sweep around the round-1 winner: corner_weight=15, more games for confidence (same as huge_cache_corner_mid, rerun for a larger combined sample)

corner_sweep_20.description: Fine sweep around the round-1 winner: corner_weight=20

corner_sweep_25.description: Fine sweep around the round-1 winner: corner_weight=25
